packages.name: workmanager
packages.breaking_notes: The '2025 rewrite' is the 0.6 -> 0.10 line, NOT 1.x (no 1.0 exists). 0.6.0 (~2025-06): Android V1 embedding removed. 0.7.0 (~2025-07): Dart 3.2/Flutter 3.16, iOS 13, targetSdk 35. 0.8.0 (~2025-07): federated split (workmanager_android/workmanager_apple), enums snake_case->camelCase (NetworkType.not_required -> notRequired), inputData no longer JSON-serialized, iOS initialDelay fix. 0.9.0 (~2025-08): debug mode replaced by hook system; periodic frequency bug fixed. 0.10.0 (~2026-08): min Flutter 3.38 across packages. Burst of 0.9.x/0.10.x releases in Aug–Sep 2026 added Android expedited work, ForegroundServiceConfig, macOS (NSBackgroundActivityScheduler, best-effort, only while app is running/backgrounded and Mac awake), onTaskStopped. Limits (docs): Android periodic >=15 min; iOS periodic is a 15-min hint, system decides; iOS/macOS one-off ~30 s runtime; iOS processing tasks 1-10 min. Windows/Linux: no stable support — on Windows run the queue in-process (tray app) instead.
packages.alternative: Actively maintained (fluttercommunity). For Windows use in-app timers + launch_at_startup/tray; background_fetch (transistorsoft) is a commercial-licensed alternative for mobile.

packages.name: flutter_web_auth_2
packages.breaking_notes: 4.x: dropped Android v1 embedding, minSdk 21, JVM 11. 5.0.0 (2025): Dart >=3.5; new Android implementation (Chrome Auth Tab); https callbacks need httpsHost/httpsPath options; ephemeralIntentFlags replaced by preferEphemeral; android:taskAffinity="" strongly recommended; iOS moved to UIScene lifecycle. 5.1.0: SecurityException handling, graceful missing authUri/callbackScheme. Desktop: Windows/Linux default (useWebview:true) embeds desktop_webview_window (WebView2 on Windows); useWebview:false launches system browser + loopback HTTP server. Loopback redirect http://127.0.0.1:PORT or http://localhost:PORT accepted (RFC 8252). macOS uses ASWebAuthenticationSession with custom scheme.
packages.alternative: Actively maintained (femtopedia.de). Alternative: roll your own loopback with dart:io HttpServer + url_launcher on desktop and app_links for custom-scheme capture on mobile.

packages.name: oauth2
packages.breaking_notes: Constructor (2.0.5): AuthorizationCodeGrant(String identifier, Uri authorizationEndpoint, Uri tokenEndpoint, {String? secret, String? delimiter, bool basicAuth = true, Client? httpClient, CredentialsRefreshedCallback? onCredentialsRefreshed, getParameters, String? codeVerifier}). PKCE added in 1.6.0; codeVerifier constructor param since 1.6.3; always sends code_challenge (S256). No breaking changes in 2.0.x; package is in maintenance mode (dart-lang/tools) with ~1 release/year. Does not handle device-code or client-credentials-with-refresh edge cases (has ClientCredentialsGrant / ResourceOwnerPasswordGrant).
packages.alternative: Fine as is. For non-standard token endpoints (Threads/Instagram long-lived tokens, X 2.0 refresh with basic auth), hand-roll the token exchange with package:http and only reuse oauth2's PKCE helper pattern.

packages.name: flutter_inappwebview

packages.alternative: package:ndk (Nostr Development Kit 0.10.1, ~2026-10-03) wraps bip340 + bech32 + relays + NIP-46/NIP-55 signers; or secp256k1 via FFI (flutter_rust_bridge) for constant-time ops.

packages.name: bech32

packages.alternative: package:ndk (includes Nip19 helpers) or copy the ~100-line bech32 implementation into NEFORUM (BSD/MIT) to avoid the dependency.

notes: All versions/dates read from pub.dev on 2026-10-07; pub.dev shows relative dates ('N days ago'), so dates marked '~' are derived from that and may be off by a day or two. Only riverpod 3.x changelog dates, flutter_timezone 5.1.1 (2026-10-03) and Dart SDK dates (dart-lang/sdk CHANGELOG) are exact.

SDK floor: the strictest dependencies are tray_manager 0.7.0 (Flutter 3.47 / Dart 3.13) and go_router 18 / riverpod 3.4 / flutter_web_auth_2 6.0.0-alpha (Flutter 3.44 / Dart 3.12). Recommended pubspec: environment: sdk: ^3.13.0, flutter: '>=3.47.0'. Platform minimums implied by the set: Android minSdk 24 (flutter_secure_storage 10+, url_launcher, image_picker), compileSdk 36-37 (flutter_local_notifications 21+, flutter_secure_storage 10.2+), AGP >= 8.12.1 / Gradle 8.13 / Kotlin 2.2 (share_plus 12+), and AGP 9 for desktop_drop 0.8+; iOS 14 (file_picker 12+); macOS 10.15 (share_plus 13, flutter_local_notifications 21, tray_manager 0.6+); Windows 10 + WebView2 runtime (flutter_inappwebview_windows).

Background posting strategy: workmanager covers Android/iOS/macOS only (no stable Windows/Linux; macOS tasks only run while the app is alive). On Windows run the scheduler in-process behind window_manager setPreventClose + tray_manager + launch_at_startup. iOS periodic tasks are system-scheduled hints (>=15 min, ~30 s budget) — scheduled posts at exact times are unreliable on iOS; pair with flutter_local_notifications zonedSchedule so the user can tap to post if the background task did not fire. drift must be opened with DriftNativeOptions(shareAcrossIsolates: true) when the workmanager isolate touches the DB.

Hand-off/share-sheet: share_plus ShareParams(text, files, subject, sharePositionOrigin) is the current API; the deprecated Share.share/Share.shareXFiles still compile in 13.x. ShareResult.raw carries the chosen iOS activity id; Android returns success/dismissed only on API 22+ via chooser callback.

OAuth: oauth2 2.0.5 AuthorizationCodeGrant generates a PKCE code_verifier automatically (S256) when codeVerifier is omitted; flutter_web_auth_2 on Windows/Linux with useWebview:false binds HttpServer to 127.0.0.1:<port parsed from callbackUrlScheme> and accepts http://localhost:PORT or http://127.0.0.1:PORT (RFC 8252 loopback); on macOS/iOS/Android use a custom scheme such as 'neforum' (RFC 3986 scheme chars only — no underscores). Register the scheme in CFBundleURLTypes (iOS/macOS) and the CallbackActivity intent-filter (Android).

Embedded WebView route: flutter_inappwebview is the only Flutter WebView with Windows support, but its last stable (6.1.5) is ~2 years old and 6.2.0 has been in beta since 2024-11 (beta.3 ~2026-02). shouldInterceptRequest works on Android and Windows only; on iOS/macOS WKWebView you can only intercept via shouldOverrideUrlLoading, custom schemes, or injected JS. CookieManager works on all four target platforms. Treat it as a pinned, risk-accepted dependency.

Crypto for Nostr: pointycastle 4.0.0 has the secp256k1 curve (verified file lib/ecc/curves/secp256k1.dart in bcgit/pc-dart) but no Schnorr/BIP-340; bip340 0.3.1 (fiatjaf) supplies sign/verify/getPublicKey over hex strings and is what ndk uses; bech32 0.2.2 is 3 years old but spec-stable and sufficient for npub/nsec/note (do your own 8->5 bit conversion; pass maxLength for NIP-19 TLV entities). No bech32m support, which Nostr does not need.

Package choices to drop: local_notifier (unmaintained, superseded by flutter_local_notifications Windows/macOS/Linux support since 19.0.0); video_thumbnail (mobile-only) in favour of fc_native_video_thumbnail 3.0.1 which covers iOS/Android/macOS/Windows/Linux. image_picker on desktop is a thin wrapper over file_selector with no resize options — use file_picker 13 on desktop and image_picker only for mobile gallery/camera.

leanflutter packages (window_manager, tray_manager, launch_at_startup) are mid-migration to the nativeapi C++ core: tray_manager already made the jump in 0.6.0 (old API in legacy.dart); window_manager's README announces the same migration, so expect a breaking window_manager release soon.
